item.title: How to use Cursor Projects
item.content:encoded: Cursor Projects gives you a coordinator agent that plans work, delegates it to subagents, keeps shared context, and watches your PRs. Here is how to use it.

item.title: JSONL: a practical guide to JSON Lines
item.content:encoded: Learn how JSONL stores one JSON value per line, how to write, stream, and query it, and why I use it as Factory Log's event store.

item.title: A deep dive into Ghostty
item.content:encoded: Ghostty from scratch: install it, learn the shortcuts, write the config, pick fonts and themes, use splits, build keybindings, set up shell integration and SSH.

item.title: AI and the joy of programming
item.content:encoded: AI made me more productive than I've ever been, but the way building software feels has changed. Some honest thoughts on where the joy went.

item.title: I updated ahastack.dev for htmx 4
item.content:encoded: ahastack.dev now runs on Astro 7 and htmx 4, has 18 live demos on Cloudflare, and ships a skill file so coding agents know how to build with the AHA stack.

item.title: Native email and password authentication on Cloudflare Workers
item.content:encoded: Build native email/password auth on Cloudflare Workers with peppered PBKDF2 hashes, D1 sessions, and hardened HttpOnly cookies.

item.title: A deep dive into tmux
item.content:encoded: Learn tmux from scratch: create persistent sessions, use windows and panes, copy text, customize key bindings, and work safely over SSH.

item.title: My software is now on GitHub
item.content:encoded: The eight packages in my software catalog are now public MIT repositories on GitHub, with the full source, tests, and documentation in one README each.

item.title: I launched CLI Tools
item.content:encoded: CLI Tools is a free, open source macOS app that catalogs every command-line tool you installed with Homebrew, npm, and Cargo, with examples, shell history, and a JSON CLI for coding agents.

item.title: The Cloudflare products I actually use
item.content:encoded: An honest report on the Cloudflare products I use in real projects, what each one solves, the gotchas I found, and what I do not use yet.

item.title: Why I think more clearly when I type
item.content:encoded: Typing is slower than speaking, but that friction helps me develop ideas, notice weak sentences, and turn rough thoughts into useful writing.

item.title: I launched Things CLI
item.content:encoded: Things CLI is a free command-line tool for creating, reading, and updating Things 3 projects and tasks from the terminal or a coding agent.

item.title: Build a language model on your Mac with Language Model Builder
item.content:encoded: Language Model Builder teaches how LLMs work and lets you train a small GPT locally on an Apple Silicon Mac, without writing code.

item.title: Why your MacBook runs hotter at high altitude
item.content:encoded: MacBooks run hotter above 1800 meters because thin air carries away less heat. Learn the physics behind it and simple ways to keep your laptop cool.

item.title: Vercel AI Gateway tutorial
item.content:encoded: Use Vercel AI Gateway with the AI SDK and OpenAI client, then add model routing, fallbacks, caching, budgets, BYOK, and observability.

item.title: How AI agents can log in without seeing your passwords
item.content:encoded: Compare 1Password Agentic Autofill, Bitwarden's Agent Access SDK, Browser Use sensitive data, OAuth token vaults, and why passkeys still block AI agents.

item.title: A deep dive into exe.dev
item.content:encoded: exe.dev gives you persistent Linux VMs over SSH, each with an HTTPS URL, private-by-default sharing, and a built-in coding agent. How it works, what it costs, and how I use it.

item.title: Zustand: simple React state management
item.content:encoded: Learn Zustand through a React store: actions, selectors, immutable updates, persistence, testing, SSR boundaries, and when local or server state is better.

item.title: Content Security Policy (CSP) explained
item.content:encoded: Build and deploy a Content Security Policy with source directives, nonces or hashes, report-only rollout, framing protection, testing, and common CSP mistakes.

item.title: Passkeys and WebAuthn explained
item.content:encoded: Understand passkeys and WebAuthn, then build registration and login with server challenges, stored public keys, SimpleWebAuthn, recovery, and tests.

item.title: Introduction to TanStack Query
item.content:encoded: Learn TanStack Query from the server-state mental model through query keys, freshness, errors, mutations, invalidation, optimistic updates, and common mistakes.

item.title: Build a documentation site with Astro and Markdown
item.content:encoded: Build a fast documentation site with Astro, Markdown collections, generated navigation, previous and next links, search, and a sitemap.

item.title: How to let an AI agent perform irreversible actions safely
item.content:encoded: A practical architecture for AI agents that spend money, deploy code, delete data, or change infrastructure without turning confirmation into a suggestion.

item.title: Build a chatbot with Cloudflare Workers AI
item.content:encoded: Build and deploy a Workers AI chatbot with the AI binding, validated conversation history, streaming responses, rate limits, cost controls, and state choices.

item.title: What happens when Bun runs a TypeScript file
item.content:encoded: Follow bun run app.ts through CLI dispatch, module resolution, TypeScript transpilation, JavaScriptCore, Node compatibility, and the event loop.

item.title: A deep dive into Cloudflare Images
item.content:encoded: How Cloudflare Images works: resize, convert and crop images with a URL or a Worker, store uploads, serve private images, and what it costs. Lots of examples.

item.title: How to stream LLM responses with server-sent events
item.content:encoded: Stream LLM text from a provider through your server to the browser with SSE, a correct buffered parser, cancellation, errors, security, and production checks.

item.title: Run a local LLM with Ollama
item.content:encoded: Run an LLM locally with Ollama, choose a model that fits, call the chat API from Node.js, stream replies, request JSON, and understand the limits.

item.title: Use AI to understand code
item.content:encoded: How I use coding agents to understand existing code before changing it: focused questions, tracing data and side effects, and reviews in a fresh session.

item.title: How to build an LLM from scratch
item.content:encoded: A practical guide for software engineers to build and train a small GPT-style language model on a Mac with Language Model Builder.
